<thought>Generate a list of up to 40 nitride compositions, retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition with an energy‑above‑hull cutoff of 0.3 eV, consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset, and return the path to the consolidated file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "AlN",
        "GaN",
        "InN",
        "BN",
        "Si3N4",
        "TiN",
        "ZrN",
        "HfN",
        "CrN",
        "MoN",
        "VN",
        "NbN",
        "TaN",
        "ScN",
        "YN",
        "Mg3N2",
        "Ca3N2",
        "Sr3N2",
        "Ba3N2",
        "Li3N",
        "Na3N",
        "K3N",
        "Be3N2",
        "Zn3N2",
        "Cd3N2",
        "SiN",
        "GeN",
        "SnN",
        "PbN",
        "FeN",
        "CoN",
        "NiN",
        "CuN",
        "AgN",
        "AuN",
        "PtN",
        "PdN",
        "IrN",
        "RhN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
